nodes.name: Trigger
nodes.notes: Not an agent tool: WF-1 calls this after the client's YES. The agent can only create a pending row (propose_booking); the calendar is written only here.

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: alwaysOutputData: an empty Settings table reaches Decide, which fails the tool (-> WF-6) instead of ending the run silently.

nodes.name: Appointments
nodes.notes: All statuses, not only the live ones: first_visit needs the done visits too.

nodes.name: Result Reject
nodes.notes: appt_id is always present (empty for NO_PENDING): Send Already Booked (Task 13) passes it to send_message, which fails without it.

nodes.name: FreeBusy
nodes.notes: Booked Slots output: one item per busy interval, {start, end} in UTC; none gives one empty {} item (alwaysOutputData). A failed calendar call fails the tool: booking blind could double-book.

nodes.name: Own Event
nodes.notes: Reached when the slot looks taken (from Taken?) or when Create Event failed (its error output). Lists the events of exactly this slot to see whether one of them is THIS booking's own event (id = Decide.event_id): then the booking already exists (a concurrent YES, or an earlier run that died before Mark Booked) and only the row needs repairing. Cancelled events are not listed. A read, so it retries.

nodes.name: Repair Booked
nodes.notes: The booking's own event already exists: make the row say so (idempotent, same values as Mark Booked). No owner message here: the run that created the event sent it (or, after a run that died before Mark Booked, nobody did; the event is in the owner's calendar either way).

nodes.name: Repair Client
nodes.notes: Same as Activate Client, for a run that died before it. Continue on error: the booking exists.

nodes.name: Alternatives
nodes.notes: check_availability also saves these slots as the client's new offer, so propose_booking accepts one of them next. Continue on error: the slot IS taken whatever happens here, so a failed lookup still answers SLOT_TAKEN (with no alternatives); check_availability's own failure reaches WF-6 from its own execution.

assignments.name: alternatives
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const m = String($json.verdict || '').match(/^(?:FREE|NONE nearest:) (.+)$/); if (!m) return ''; const tz = $('Settings').first().json.fields.timezone; return m[1].split(', ').slice(0, 3).map(x => DateTime.fromISO(x).setZone(tz)).filter(d => d.isValid).map(d => d.toFormat('ccc, LLL d, h:mm a')).join('; '); })() }}

nodes.name: Create Event
nodes.notes: The event id is Decide.event_id, derived from appt_id, so Google refuses a second event for the same booking (409 duplicate). That makes the retry safe (a retry after a create that timed out but succeeded gets the 409) and stops two concurrent YES runs from making two events. Error output -> Own Event: if this booking's event is there, the row is repaired and the answer is ALREADY_BOOKED (no second owner message); if not, Own Check fails the tool (-> WF-6).

nodes.name: Activate Client
nodes.notes: new/active -> active. A flagged or escalated client keeps that status: a booking must not silently clear the owner's flag. Continue on error: the booking already exists (event and booked row), so the client must still get BOOKED.

nodes.name: Replaces?
nodes.notes: A reschedule (the pending row carries replaces_appt_id, validated by propose_booking): true -> Cancel Replaced. The repair path has its own Replaces Repair? into the same Cancel Replaced.

nodes.name: Notify
nodes.notes: Continue on error: the booking already exists (event in the owner's calendar, row booked), so the client must get BOOKED even if the owner message fails. notify_owner retries its own nodes and has an Airtable-free fallback.

value.text: ={{ '✅ New booking: ' + (String($('Client').first().json.fields.name || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 80) || '(no name)') + ' (' + $('Trigger').first().json.contact_id + ') — ' + $('Decide').first().json.service_name + ' — ' + DateTime.fromISO($('Decide').first().json.start_iso).setZone($('Settings').first().json.fields.timezone).toFormat('ccc, LLL d, h:mm a') + ' — ' + $('Decide').first().json.appt_id + ($('Decide').first().json.replaces_appt_id ? ' — replaces ' + $('Decide').first().json.replaces_appt_id : '') }}

nodes.name: Replaces Repair?
nodes.notes: The repair path (this booking's event already existed) must still free the visit it replaces: an earlier run that died after Create Event never got to Cancel Replaced. If that run did cancel it, cancel_booking answers NOT_FOUND (idempotent).

nodes.name: Cancel Replaced
nodes.notes: Reschedule: cancel_booking with reason=reschedule (always cancelled, never a late cancel, owner told 'Rescheduled'). Continue on error: the new booking already exists, so the client must get BOOKED / ALREADY_BOOKED; Replace Failed? tells the owner to cancel the old visit by hand.

nodes.name: Replace Failed?
nodes.notes: CANCELLED = the old visit is freed; NOT_FOUND = it was already cancelled (by an earlier run of this booking, or by hand). Anything else (an error item, NOT_YOURS) means the old visit may still be booked.

nodes.name: Notify Replace Failed
nodes.notes: Continue on error: nothing else can be done here; cancel_booking's own failure also reached WF-6 from its own execution.

value.text: ={{ '⚠️ Reschedule incomplete: ' + (String($('Client').first().json.fields.name || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 80) || '(no name)') + ' (' + $('Trigger').first().json.contact_id + ') is booked for ' + $('Decide').first().json.appt_id + ' (' + $('Decide').first().json.service_name + ' — ' + DateTime.fromISO($('Decide').first().json.start_iso).setZone($('Settings').first().json.fields.timezone).toFormat('ccc, LLL d, h:mm a') + '), but the old visit ' + $('Decide').first().json.replaces_appt_id + ' could not be cancelled automatically (' + String($json.verdict || ($json.error && ($json.error.message || JSON.stringify($json.error))) || 'no answer').slice(0, 200) + '). Cancel it by hand: delete its calendar event and set its Appointments row to cancelled.' }}

nodes.name: Repaired?
nodes.notes: Back to the path Cancel Replaced was called from: the repair path answers ALREADY_BOOKED without a new-booking message, the normal path goes on to Notify.
